atlantis-ch1.title: Chapter 1 — The City Beneath the Sea
atlantis-ch1.subtitle: The Heart of Atlantis: The Fivefold Choice

female.backgroundStory: Alethea guarded the Lower Archives, studying the ancient principles of Atlantis: discipline of the heart, mind, and character. She believed a city did not collapse when its walls broke, but when its people stopped caring that the walls were weakening. Patient and observant, she noticed what others ignored. Yet she carried responsibility alone.

dialogue.speaker: Alethea
dialogue.text: Below the ocean domes, the Five Crystals keep our ocean realm alive. But a fissure is forming beneath the Heart Chamber.

dialogue.speaker: Alethea
dialogue.text: People began choosing convenience over honesty and profit over service. The Heart noticed, and its blue light began to flicker.

dialogue.speaker: Alethea
dialogue.text: We cannot wait for the walls to collapse. We must restore knowledge with compassion and strength with purpose.

male.backgroundStory: Elion was Atlantis's greatest warrior. Strong, celebrated, and undefeated, he had protected the city many times. But his victories had made him lonely. He believed needing others was weakness and pushed himself beyond his limits. His greatest fear was simple: if he stopped being the strongest, who would he be?

dialogue.speaker: Elion
dialogue.text: I woke tonight with a strange blue mark glowing on my palm. In my dreams, Atlantis was flooding while I stood helpless.

dialogue.speaker: Elion
dialogue.text: I have fought a hundred battles for this ocean city, but true strength isn't fought alone in darkness.

dialogue.speaker: Elion
dialogue.text: When every light in Atlantis went out, I knew the Heart had summoned us.

female.backgroundStory: The Day of Founding was in full celebration when the Heart suddenly pulsed. The music stopped. The fountains froze. The city went dark. A section of the eastern dome began to buckle.

dialogue.speaker: Alethea
dialogue.text: The eastern dome is losing pressure! If we close the main gate, the southern districts lose oxygen.

dialogue.speaker: Elion
dialogue.text: And if we leave it open, the east floods! We need a third option!

dialogue.speaker: Alethea
dialogue.text: The abandoned maintenance tunnels beneath the plaza — we can redirect pressure through them!

male.backgroundStory: The Day of Founding was in full celebration when the Heart suddenly pulsed. A section of the eastern dome began to buckle as alarm sirens wailed across Atlantis.

dialogue.speaker: Elion
dialogue.text: Move, Alethea! I can lift the emergency panel when it collapses!

dialogue.speaker: Alethea
dialogue.text: I know the control systems better than anyone. We can redirect pressure through the maintenance tunnels.

dialogue.speaker: Elion
dialogue.text: Sounds dangerous. Good, I understand dangerous. Let's make our choice.

Best.title: Protect Everyone Together (Win4All)
Best.description: Alethea organizes the evacuation while Elion coordinates citizens, builders, and medics.

dialogues.speaker: Elion
dialogues.text: Strong people carry equipment! Not people who can walk! Everybody moves together!

dialogues.speaker: Alethea
dialogues.text: We saved every citizen. Even when doing the right thing has consequences, Win4All builds true resilience.

Best.feedbackReadBack: True leadership creates a Win4All outcome where everyone contributes and no one is left behind.

Safe.title: Seal the Eastern Dome
Safe.description: Elion closes the eastern gate immediately, protecting the central city. The southern districts lose oxygen.

dialogues.speaker: Alethea
dialogues.text: Yes. But safety without cooperation can still leave people behind.

Safe.feedbackReadBack: Playing it safe alone protects the core but risks leaving vulnerable teammates isolated.

Weak.title: Wait for the Council
Weak.description: They hesitate, waiting for official instructions. The Council remains silent while water rises.

dialogues.speaker: Elion
dialogues.text: I could have stopped it if I didn't hesitate!

dialogues.speaker: Alethea
dialogues.text: We both waited for someone else to become responsible.

Weak.feedbackReadBack: Delaying action out of fear of responsibility leads to avoidable loss for the entire community.

Harmful.title: Fight for Control
Harmful.description: Elion tries to force the machinery open while Alethea overrides the system. Their argument breaks the mechanism.

dialogues.speaker: Alethea
dialogues.text: Strength without discipline is not protection!

dialogues.speaker: Elion
dialogues.text: For once... I have no answer.

Harmful.feedbackReadBack: Conflict and stubborn control destroy the very foundations we are trying to save.

female.backgroundStory: Elena lead the product team during their most critical launch quarter. When communication broke down between marketing and dev, she stood up to unify the team.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: I cannot stand how disorganized our project roadmap is right now!

dialogue.speaker: Teammate
dialogue.text: It sounds like you're feeling overwhelmed, but we can structure a clear plan together.

male.backgroundStory: Marcus was appointed lead founder. With investor deadlines looming, he had to demonstrate composed leadership.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: We have 48 hours before the funding pitch. We need clear leadership now!

dialogue.speaker: Teammate
dialogue.text: Let's align our strengths and present a unified vision.

Best.title: Leader — Empower the Team
Best.description: Establish clear ownership, active listening, and structured deadlines.

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: Let's break it down into four actionable pillars where everyone takes clear ownership!

Best.feedbackReadBack: A great leader empowers others by creating clarity, trust, and shared accountability.

Safe.title: Postpone the Meeting
Safe.description: Delay decision-making to gather more data.

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: We avoid immediate conflict, but momentum is lost.

Safe.feedbackReadBack: Playing safe avoids risk but delays innovation.

Weak.title: Micromanage Tasks

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: I'll just do it all myself...

Weak.feedbackReadBack: Micromanagement burns out the leader and demoralizes the team.

Harmful.title: Blame Other Departments

dialogues.speaker: Leader
dialogues.text: It's entirely their fault we missed the target!

Harmful.feedbackReadBack: Blaming others destroys team psychological safety.
